mission: Ship AI into enterprise products that already have users, SLAs, and messy data.
responsibilities: Built RAG over ServiceNow with permission-aware retrieval and citations.
Designed a Simulated Annealing workforce scheduler (~3 hours of manual planning → ~50 seconds).
Built hybrid ranking for recruitment — semantic retrieval plus deterministic scores.
Wired agent workflows into SAP and ServiceNow with tracing and human review on outbound actions.
growth: I stopped treating demos as progress. If it can't be evaluated or rolled back, it isn't finished.
lessons: Most failures show up at boundaries — APIs, documents, tickets — not in the model card.
If you can't explain a score or a draft to a reviewer, don't ship it.

mission: Ship and maintain production apps under release pressure.
responsibilities: Owned shared libraries and performance-sensitive surfaces.
Ran CI/CD and releases for client apps that couldn't afford casual breakage.
Published redacted on pub.dev after rebuilding the same skeleton UI once too often.
growth: I learned to prefer operable designs over clever ones. That preference transferred intact into AI work.
lessons: You find out what your architecture is worth the week after launch.
